name: Optically Thin Approximation Correction
definition: First-order correction terms to improve the accuracy of the optically thin approximation by modeling photon loss from Sun to scattering point and scattering point to spacecraft.
summary: Optically Thin Approximation Correction improves single-scattering accuracy by applying exponential attenuation factors for absorption and secondary scattering along both the Sun-to-scatterer and scatterer-to-observer paths.
